reason: The Verus spec models boolean slot type invariant at the compile-time boundary. However, the current production type system (CompileError enum, vb_core types) does NOT track slot value types at compile time. The spec is a formal model of the desired invariant, but it cannot be bound to production Rust behavior without a type-system extension (compile-time slot type tracking). This is an existing gap identified in hazard H9 and Non-Goals item 4 ("Compile-time boolean slot type validation"). The Verus spec documents the invariant; production enforcement is deferred to a future bead.
boundary_proof: The spec fn models: for any slot_from_text result used as condition, the slot holds Bool at runtime. The exec fn lower_canonical_choose calls slot_from_text for each branch.when. The gap is that the compiler cannot reject a non-boolean condition at compile time — it can only produce a runtime Internal error.
compensating_evidence: PO-KANI-009 verifies that replay_choose_slot gracefully handles non-Bool condition values (returns Internal error, no UB). Runtime unit tests (choose_slot_non_boolean_condition_returns_internal_error) validate this path.

reason: PS-CONCURRENCY-001 is explicitly tagged behavior_affecting: false. The choose dispatch at runtime is single-threaded per workflow run. No tokio::spawn, Arc<Mutex>, channels, or Atomic* types exist in the affected compilation or replay code paths. Hazard H11 confirms: "No process-level concurrency hazard exists for choose nodes themselves." Loom is not applicable because there are no concurrent interleavings to test.
boundary_proof: The replay engine (vb_core/src/replay/choose.rs:12-58) operates on &mut RunFrame — a sequential, single-threaded operation. The compiler lowering (vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_02.rs:216-293) is purely sequential. No concurrency primitives are used.
compensating_evidence: Existing replay unit tests (7 tests in vb_core/src/replay/choose.rs) cover runtime dispatch paths. The choose-within-together scenario (where parallel branches each have a choose) is protected by Together isolation of slot writes per branch.
